mentions.name: Routine tracker app
mentions.description: This app lets users create programs, schedules, and routines for the things they consistently work on in a structured way, such as workout programs, music practice, and language study. It is currently in the internal testing phase of the Play Store and is being prepared for release this month.
mentions.problem: The author couldn't find an existing app that could be used across multiple interests to structure recurring programs and routines, so they built one themselves.
mentions.audience: A single user originally, as no existing app could be used across the author's interests; now being released publicly on the Play Store.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on a routine tracker app. I have been searching for an app where I could create programs, schedules and routines for various things that I consistently work on in a structured way (ex. workout program, music practice, language study, etc.)
